title: Xtra Power Fabric Cleaner Spray 500ml | Multi-Surface Fabric Cleaner for Sofa, Carpet, Upholstery, Curtains, Car Seats & Mattresses | Deep Cleaning Stain Remover | Odor Eliminator
description: Keep your home and vehicle interiors looking clean and refreshed with Xtra Power Fabric Cleaner Spray 500ml. This multi-surface fabric cleaning solution is specially formulated to help remove everyday dirt, stains, and unwanted odors from a variety of fabric surfaces while leaving them fresh and clean. The fast-drying, non-sticky formula makes cleaning quick and convenient without leaving heavy residue behind. 🛋️ Suitable for sofas, carpets, upholstery, curtains, mattresses, cushions, dining chairs, office chairs, fabric furniture, and car seats, this versatile cleaner is ideal for everyday household and automotive cleaning. ✨ The advanced cleaning formula helps lift common stains, dust, and surface grime while maintaining the appearance of your fabric surfaces. It also helps eliminate unpleasant odors, leaving fabrics feeling fresh after cleaning. 💧 The quick-drying formula minimizes drying time, allowing cleaned surfaces to be ready for use sooner. Its non-sticky finish helps prevent residue buildup and provides a clean feel after every application. 🚗 The convenient spray bottle delivers an even mist for controlled application, making it easy to clean both large and small fabric areas. Simply spray, allow the formula to work for a few moments, gently wipe or brush, and let the surface air dry. 🏠 Perfect for use at home, in offices, hotels, cars, and other fabric-covered spaces. For best results, always test on a small hidden area before full application. Choose Xtra Power Fabric Cleaner Spray to help maintain clean, fresh, and well-cared-for fabric surfaces as part of your regular cleaning routine
